handling (COALESCE / fillna), and re-run BOTH from scratch until

match (SQL has no native percentile), continue increasing precision
until SQL approximation converges to pandas.

         OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salesforce__opportunity_enhanced WHERE amount > 100000) / 2
        ) as median_amount
    FROM salesforce__opportunity_enhanced 
    WHERE amount > 100000
""")
sql_results = cursor.fetchone()
conn.close()

sql_stats = {
    'MIN': sql_results[0],
    'MAX': sql_results[1],
    'MEAN': sql_results[2],
    'MEDIAN': sql_results[3]
}

print("\nSQL Statistics for amount > 100000:")
for stat, value in zip(['MIN', 'MAX', 'MEAN', 'MEDIAN'], sql_results):
    print(f"{stat}: {value:.2f}")

# Compare results
print("\nComparison (Pandas vs SQL):")
for stat in amount_stats.keys():
    pandas_val = amount_stats[stat]
    sql_val = sql_stats[stat]
    diff = abs(pandas_val - sql_val)
    match = "✓" if diff < 0.01 else f"✗ (diff: {diff:.6f})"
    print(f"{stat}: Pandas={pandas_val:.2f}, SQL={sql_val:.2f} {match}")
